import json
from pathlib import Path

from src.greeting import greeting

CONFIG_PATH = Path("config/app.json")

if not CONFIG_PATH.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("Lantern configuration error: config/app.json is missing.")

print(greeting(json.loads(CONFIG_PATH.read_text())["audience"]))
